prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 中英混排 · 会议待办 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "#" · longest unbreakable word 11px · one-line width 11px
  col 2: header "Action item" · longest unbreakable word 87px · one-line width 536px
  col 3: header "负责人" · longest unbreakable word 33px · one-line width 53px
  col 4: header "Due" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 35px
  col 5: header "状态" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 53px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 480px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 479px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"记录会议行动项，明确负责人、截止日期和执行状态，便于后续跟进。","reading":"读者先按行识别行动项，再横向查看负责人、截止日期和状态；也会纵向扫描截止日期和状态以确定跟进优先级。较长的行动项会形成多行，同行的其他单元格可利用这些行高。","groups":["负责人、Due 和状态共同描述行动项的执行与跟进信息。","# 和 Action item 共同用于定位和识别每条任务。"],"keep_intact":["序号","负责人姓名中的不可拆分部分","截止日期","状态标签中的不可拆分部分","英文单词、缩写和产品名称中的不可拆分部分"],"may_wrap":["行动项描述可在中文字符之间或英文单词之间自然换行。","由多个词组成的负责人或状态值可在自然边界换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [39, 226, 72, 62, 77] · table 477×329px · row heights [66, 66, 92, 66, 39] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [39, 265, 54, 55, 64] · table 478×382px · row heights [92, 66, 92, 66, 66] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 1
Design r0C: widths [39, 206, 72, 82, 77] · table 477×382px · row heights [66, 66, 118, 92, 39] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Constraint adjustments applied: r0A: raised a column to the minimum 40px; scaled down from 487px to fit 479px
r0B: raised a column to the minimum 40px; scaled down from 487px to fit 479px
r0C: raised a column to the minimum 40px; scaled down from 487px to fit 479px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"行动项有足够空间保持英文单词完整；负责人、日期和状态值也都易于横向对应，四条任务的行高节奏相对紧凑。","problems":"“负责人”表头断成两行，削弱了表头的整体节奏；较长的行动项仍需两至三行。","cause":"负责人列为72px，扣除21px后只有51px，略小于表头所需的53px；行动项列为226px，长描述只能换行。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"行动项列最宽，第一条和第三条描述的换行较少。","problems":"负责人表头竖向占三行；“王强”、部分日期和所有状态被拆开，妨碍纵向扫描，也让短任务的行高变大。","cause":"负责人、Due和状态列分别只有54px、55px和64px，扣除内边距后分别只剩33px、34px和43px，无法容纳较宽的姓名、日期或状态值。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"负责人、日期和状态值保持完整，跟进信息排列清楚。","problems":"负责人表头仍换行；行动项列偏窄，使第二、第三条任务分别拉长，第三条达到四行，文字与右侧留白失衡。","cause":"负责人列72px仍不足以容纳完整表头；行动项列只有206px，而Due列82px明显宽于其内容所需。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-follow-up","widths":[40,235,74,56,74],"change":"以r0A为基础，将负责人列增至74px以容纳完整表头；Due和状态列按内容需求收紧，把节省的宽度交给行动项。56px的Due列保留35px内容空间，恰好容纳最长日期。"},{"name":"date-cushion","widths":[40,231,74,60,74],"change":"保留完整负责人表头和状态值，并给日期多留4px余量；行动项比r0A略宽，作为更重视日期列呼吸感的备选。"}]}
